opening: Thank you for your interest in the FP&A analyst role. The questions will focus on your verified planning, forecasting, Excel modelling, and the unverified SQL area.

questions.question: Walk me through your monthly forecasting process and how you review assumptions before sharing a forecast.
questions.purpose: Assess the depth of verified forecasting practice.
questions.follow_up_if_weak: Which assumption would you validate first, and what evidence would you use?

questions.question: Describe how you build and check Excel financial models for planning work.
questions.purpose: Evaluate the confirmed modelling skill that is relevant to FP&A work.
questions.follow_up_if_weak: How would you make a model easier for another analyst to review?

questions.question: Imagine a hypothetical forecast variance of 15%. How would you investigate the drivers and decide whether the model or business assumptions need revision?
questions.purpose: Test forecasting reasoning with a supplied hypothetical parameter rather than an invented candidate achievement.
questions.follow_up_if_weak: What evidence would help you distinguish a modelling issue from a business change?

questions.question: The role requires scenario modelling. How would you structure base, upside, and downside scenarios using your existing Excel modelling experience?
questions.purpose: Assess transfer from confirmed Excel modelling to a vacancy requirement without claiming prior scenario-modelling experience.
questions.follow_up_if_weak: Which assumptions would you isolate so that the scenarios remain easy to compare?

questions.question: SQL is preferred but not verified in your background. How would you approach learning enough SQL to support FP&A analysis?
questions.purpose: Explore the SQL gap without assuming production SQL experience.
questions.follow_up_if_weak: During a hypothetical first 90 days, what small SQL learning milestone would you set for yourself?

closing: Thank you. These answers will help distinguish verified strengths from areas that would require development for the role.
